Andy Devine Avenue is a street located in the Kingman, Arizona, area, in the United States. Is is considered a primary street through Downtown alongside with Beale Steet, 1st Street, and 4th Street. The street has strong ties with city's history and Historic U.S. Route 66 (Historic US 66).
Future
After nearly seven decades of Front Street being renamed, on May 27, 2025, the commission was faced with a preservation dilemma during a meeting to either keep the name as Andy Devine Avenue to preserve the legacy of Devine and his family, or change the street name to Route 66 for the upcoming Route 66 Centennial.
